title: Netflix Confirms New K-Pop Audition Series ‘We Go High’ and Opens Casting for Arts High School’s Brightest Stars
summary: Netflix has confirmed the production of its K-pop audition project, We Go High, where top students from arts high schools compete with their cherished dreams and their school’s honor on the line. Recruitment begins today, October 21, 2026.
body_markdown:
We Go High


is Netflix Korea’s K-pop girl group audition project, set at an arts high school, where students major in their dreams. True to its title, the series promises to capture the pure passion of arts school students striving to reach new heights and bring their talents to a bigger stage. Representing top arts high schools across Korea, these talented students will face off against formidable rivals while building the kind of chemistry it takes to become a group. The project is expected to broaden K-pop’s global fandom and bring together a girl group chosen through the eyes of the world.


Applications for


We Go High


are open to first- and second-year high school students at high schools with arts and entertainment-related programs, as well as those set to enter such schools in 2027. Full application details are available on Netflix Korea’s official social media channels.


Known for their bold, distinctive concepts in reality television, top entertainment producers Park Jin-kyung and Lee Jae-seok of Monsterahaus direct and produce the series.


To provide continued support for the girl group formed through


We Go High


, Netflix has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with SM C&C for mutual collaboration to foster the group’s ongoing growth and activities beyond their debut.
